text:
Nina S.: Quick note from today's GTM sync: Azure Marketplace is asking if our Datadog tile can be packaged as a multi-cloud observability bundle (DD tile + Azure Monitor integration + curated dashboards). Interested in feasibility and cost implications.
Carlos (cloud): technically doable but two asks: 1) a single onboarding flow in the marketplace listing that provisions both DD and Azure telemetry exports, and 2) clearly separated billing/usage so customers don't get double-charged for metrics.
Eve (eng): on the infra side we'll need to support dual exporters in the collector config and provide example dashboard JSONs for both DD and Azure Monitor workbooks. Also watch cardinality across both remote ingest endpoints.
Lena M. (product): Marketing wants one-liner variants per marketplace (Azure/Datadog/GCP) and a short FAQ about data residency. Can legal draft a line about no prompt text exported?
Rashid (si): SI partners asked for an onboarding guide for private deployments (air-gapped) — they need offline dashboard JSON and a way to import metrics into their Prometheus/VMware stacks.
Nina S.: Good call. Can we sketch required artifacts and owners here?
Eve (eng): Artifacts: 1) dual-export collector config example; 2) dashboard JSON (DD) + workbook JSON (Azure Monitor); 3) billing recommendations doc; 4) privacy/retention blurb. I can own (1) and (2).
Carlos (cloud): I'll draft the billing/usage recommendation with cost delta estimates for token/metric egress. Need sample QPS and metric cardinality numbers from eng.
Lena M. (product): I'll coordinate with Legal for the privacy blurb and with Marketing for one-liners.
Rashid (si): I'll prepare the offline import instructions and a lightweight script to convert our dashboard JSON into Azure workbook format for SI installs. Will need a sample metrics dump.
Nina S.: integrations-bot, create a partner epic for this bundle and assign owners. Also schedule a 30m engineering smoke test with Azure cert team and DD validation.
integrations-bot: Created epic RDW-5201: "Multi-cloud observability bundle (Datadog + Azure Monitor)" assigned to Eve (eng), Carlos (cloud), and Lena M. Due: 2025-06-10.
Eve (eng): Prototype collector snippet (keeps it simple):
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    api_key: "<DD_STAGE_KEY>"
  azuremonitor:
    instrumentation_key: "<AZURE_KEY>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog, azuremonitor]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/datadog, azuremonitor]
```
Eve (eng): Note: we'll add an exporter toggle so customers can enable one or both. Also will add rw.region resource attribute for data residency mapping.
Carlos (cloud): For billing: rough estimate - adding azuremonitor exporter increases outbound egress by ~K MB/day per 10k requests; I'll quantify after Eve shares expected metric sizes.
Lena M. (product): Timeline proposal: prototypes by next Thu, smoke test with partners the following week, marketplace packaging the week after. Any blockers?
Rashid (si): blocker: SI needs offline dashboard conversion tooling by next Wed to prep private installs. I'll pair with Eve on the dashboard JSON format.
Nina S.: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as the single source for bundle coordination. Ping if anything slips.
